observations.body: The disciples’ question about greatness precedes Jesus’s contrast between rulers and servants.
observations.label: Dispute

observations.body: Jesus addresses Simon twice, names Satan’s demand, and says he has prayed that Simon’s faith not fail.
observations.label: Intercession

observations.body: A future turning and strengthening of brothers is named before Simon’s promise and the denial prediction.
observations.label: Return

payload.posture: Do not isolate the denial prediction from the dispute, prayer, return, and commission that surround it.
payload.tension: Simon’s future strengthening of others is spoken beside testing, turning, and imminent denial.
payload.title: Simon, Simon
